newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent extends losses in late trading.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent extends losses in late trading.

text.p: SIMEX Brent December crude futures extended losses by late afternoon on Wednesday in line with a weaker NYMEX over product stock builds in the U.S..
December Brent was last traded at $23.50 per barrel -- the intraday low -- down 24 cents from the London settlement on Tuesday. Market volume was 400 lots.
Meanwhile, NYMEX December crude trading on the after-hours ACCESS system was last traded at $24.29 per barrel, but was bid at $24.12.
Brokers said the downward pressure was prompted by the distillate build in American Petroleum Institute (API) data issued on Tuesday after the NYMEX close.
API said distillate stocks grew 3.59 million barrels in the week ending October 25, compared with expectations that the build would be 1.9 million barrels.
One broker said Brent fell below support at $23.70, which could encourage the bears in the market but at the same time some technical indications suggested the market was oversold.
